acceptanceCriteria: Measured fast-route cost at 1k and 10k tickets shows no growth with ticket count.
Refused and replayed writes at 13k receipts complete in a recorded bound well under the complete audit.
body:
Parent: V1-0645. Observed: on the writer fast route, evidence lstat calls and attempt reads grow with ticket count; refused or replayed writes still take the complete route (about 8 s at 13k receipts). Expected: cost proportional to the touched ticket, and refusals and replays on a bounded route.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).

All hosted CI checks passed. ci-control-plane was admin-posted on head 1ec61878 with the owner's explicit authorization for the .github/cishards changes. The batch CEM was bound and sealed (dogfood check PASS), and Codex reviewed the integration. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0915-0918-writer-fast-route.md at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256); the build log records the focused tests and limits.
